bio.text: James Gallagher represents California's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; he took the oath of office on June 10, 2026, after winning a June 2 special election to fill the seat of the late Rep. Doug LaMalfa.
He served in the California State Assembly from 2014 to 2026, including as minority leader from 2022 to 2025, and earlier served six years on the Sutter County Board of Supervisors.
He graduated from East Nicolaus High School, earned a B.A. from UC Berkeley and a law degree from UC Davis, and works as an attorney and farmer.

sources.title: James Gallagher sworn in to finish LaMalfa's term in the House
